no2_avg = no2_data.groupby('borough')['NO2_value'].mean().reset_index()

# Compute neighbor NO2 values for each borough
neighbor_no2 = adjacency_list.merge(no2_avg, left_on='borough', right_on='borough', how='left')
neighbor_no2 = neighbor_no2.merge(no2_avg, left_on='neighbor', right_on='borough', how='left')
neighbor_no2 = neighbor_no2.drop_duplicates(subset=['borough', 'neighbor'])
neighbor_no2 = neighbor_no2.groupby('borough')['NO2_value_y'].mean().reset_index()
